title: From photocatalysis to photon–phonon co-driven catalysis for methanol reforming to hydrogen and valuable by-products
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, 54,2188-2207
DOI: 10.1039/D4CS00551A, Review Article
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Hui Wang, Eleana Harkou, Achilleas Constantinou, Sultan M. Al-Salemc, George Manos, Junwang Tang
This review discusses methanol reforming for H2 and valuable chemical synthesis by photocatalysis and photon–phonon co-driven processes, respectively, including catalyst design, mechanistic insights, reactor design strategies, etc.
